spans.s: कण् (I) vt. or vi. 1P (pp. कणित) 1. To sound; 2. to become small; 3. to go.
कण् (II) vi. 10P (pp. कणित) To wink, to close the eye with the lids.
कण m. 1. A grain, M.xi.92; 2. a grain of dust; 3. a drop (of water), spray, कणवाही मालिनीतरंगाणाम् Sak.iii., नवजलकणैः Megh.vii.26, 45, ii.6, Am.
; 4. an ear of corn; 5. an atom, a minute particle; 6. a very small quantity, Sant.S.iii.5.
काण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. One-eyed, M.iii.155, 177, 242; 2. perforated, broken (as a cowri), प्राप्तः काणवराटकोपि न मया तृष्णेधुना मुंच माम् Bhartr.iii.5.
काण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. One-eyed, M.iii.155, 177, 242; 2. perforated, broken (as a cowri), प्राप्तः काणवराटकोपि न मया तृष्णेधुना मुंच माम् Bhartr.iii.5.
कण-अद, -भक्ष, -भुज् m. a nickname of the philosopher who promulgated the Vaiśeṣika system of philosophy.
कण-अद, -भक्ष, -भुज् m. a nickname of the philosopher who promulgated the Vaiśeṣika system of philosophy.
कण-अद, -भक्ष, -भुज् m. a nickname of the philosopher who promulgated the Vaiśeṣika system of philosophy.
कण-प m. a kind of a spear, चापचक्रकणपकर्षणप्रासपट्टिशमुसलतोमरदिप्रहरणजालम् D.K.
कण-भक्षक m. a kind of bird.
कण-लाभ m. a whirlpool.
कण-शस् ind. particle by particle, drop by drop, grain by grain, little by little, K.S.iv.27.
कणिक m. 1. A grain; 2. a small particle; 3. an ear of corn.
कणिका f. 1. An atom, a particle; 2. a drop (of water), Megh.ii.35; 3. a kind of corn.
कणीक a. (f. का) Small, diminutive.
कणीक a. (f. का) Small, diminutive.
कणिश m.n. A ear of corn.
कणे ind. A particle expressing the satisfying of a desire, कणेहत्य पयः पिबति ‘he drinks milk till he is satisfied.’
कणेरा(रु) f. 1. A she-elephant; 2. a courtezan.
काणेय(र) m. Son of a one-eyed woman.
कणेरा(रु) f. 1. A she-elephant; 2. a courtezan.
कण्व m. The name of a sage. (See App. II.)
कण्व-दुहितृ, -सुता f. Śakuntalā, Kaṇva’s daughter.
कण्व-दुहितृ, -सुता f. Śakuntalā, Kaṇva’s daughter.
काणेय(र) m. Son of a one-eyed woman.
काणेली f. 1. An unchaste woman; 2. an unmarried woman.
काणेली-मातृ m. the son of an unmarried woman, (a term of reproach generally used in the voc. काणेलीमातः अस्ति किंचिच्चिह्नं यदुपलक्षयसि Mrich.i.).
